basic.name: Kanshou and Bakuya
basic.description_template: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy.

skill.name: Caladbolg II: Fake Spiral Sword
skill.description_template: Enters the "Circuit Connection" state. Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy. After using Skill in the "Circuit Connection" state, the current turn does not end and the DMG dealt by Archer's Skill increases by 100%. This effect can stack up to 2 time(s), lasting until he exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After actively using Skill 5 time(s) or when Skill Points are insufficient, exits the "Circuit Connection" state. After all enemy targets are defeated in each wave, exits the "Circuit Connection" state.

ultimate.name: Unlimited Blade Works
ultimate.description_template: Deals Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Archer's ATK to one designated enemy and gains 2 point(s) of Charge, up to a maximum of 4.

talent.name: Mind's Eye (True)
talent.description_template: After Archer's teammates attack enemy targets, Archer consumes 1 Charge and immediately launches a Follow-Up ATK on the primary target, dealing Quantum DMG equal to {{damage}}% of Archer's ATK and recovering 1 Skill Point. If the target is defeated before the Follow-Up ATK is launched, it will instead target one random enemy.

technique.name: Clairvoyance
technique.description: Immediately attacks enemies. After entering combat, deals Quantum DMG equal to 200% of Archer's ATK to all enemies and gains 1 point of Charge.

2.name: Projection Magecraft
2.description: When Archer is on the field, increases the maximum Skill Point limit by 2.

4.name: Hero of Justice
4.description: When Archer enters combat, gains 1 point of Charge.

6.name: Guardian
6.description: After allies gain a Skill Point, if there are 4 Skill Points or more, increases Archer's CRIT DMG by 120% for 1 turn.

eidolons.name: The Unreached Dream
eidolons.description: After using Skill 3 time(s) within one turn, recovers 2 Skill Point(s) for allies.

eidolons.name: The Unfulfilled Happiness
eidolons.description: When using Ultimate, reduces the enemy target's Quantum RES by 20% and applies Quantum Weakness to it, lasting for 2 turn(s).

eidolons.name: The Untamed Will
eidolons.description:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: The Unsung Life
eidolons.description: Increases the Ultimate DMG dealt by 150%.

eidolons.name: The Nameless Watch
eidolons.description:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: The Endless Pilgrimage
eidolons.description: When the turn starts, recovers 1 Skill Point for allies. The maximum number of stacks for the DMG boost effect from this unit's Skill increases by 1. Skill DMG dealt ignores 20% of DEF.
